info.name: LMS_API
info.description:
## LMS API

This collection provides a complete set of REST API endpoints for a **Learning Management System (LMS)** backend. It is organized into the following functional modules:

### Authentication & User Management

Handles user registration, email verification, login, token refresh, logout, password reset, and instructor account creation. Bearer token authentication is configured at the collection level using the `{{access_token}}` variable.

### Courses & Categories

Supports full CRUD operations for courses and course categories, enabling instructors and admins to create, update, and manage the course catalog.

### Lessons

Covers creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting lessons within a course, as well as marking lessons as complete for progress tracking.

### Enrollments

Allows students to enroll in courses, view their enrollments, and manage enrollment records.

### Assignments & Submissions

Manages assignment creation by instructors, student submissions (including file attachments), resubmissions, and instructor grading.

### Quizzes & Quiz Attempts

Supports quiz creation, question management, and the full quiz attempt lifecycle — starting, submitting, and reviewing attempts.

### Examinations & Exam Attempts

Covers examination scheduling, question management, and the exam attempt flow including essay grading.

### Grades & Results

Provides endpoints for listing grades and viewing student results per course.

### Certificates

Handles certificate issuance, retrieval, update, and deletion for course completions.

### Notifications

Enables listing notifications, marking individual or all notifications as read, and checking unread counts.

### Reviews

Supports creating, reading, updating, and deleting course reviews by students.

### Analytics

Exposes analytics endpoints for students, instructors, and admins to track performance and platform usage.

---

**Base URL:** `{{base_url}}` (defaults to the deployed Render demo). Change the collection variable when testing locally.

**Auth:** Bearer token via `{{access_token}}` — obtain a token using the Login request in the Auth folder.

**Demo credentials:** `{{admin_demo}}`, `{{instructor1_demo}}`, `{{instructor2_demo}}`, `{{student1_demo}}`, `{{student2_demo}}`. The admin demo password is `{{password_demo}}`; for instructor/student logins, use the same variable after changing its value to `DemoInstructor123!` or `DemoStudent123!` as appropriate.

**Collection variables only:** tokens and resource IDs are stored with `pm.collectionVariables.set(...)`; no Postman environment is required.

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Registers a new student account on the platform.

Accepts `email`, `first_name`, `last_name`, `password`, and `password_confirm`. On success, creates a `User` with the STUDENT role, a linked `StudentProfile`, and sends a verification email containing a one-time token.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** None required  
**Body (JSON):**
- `email` (string, required) — must be unique
- `first_name` (string, required)
- `last_name` (string, required)
- `password` (string, required)
- `password_confirm` (string, required) — must match password

**Response:** 201 Created — user details  
**Notes:** The account is inactive until the email is verified via the Verify Email endpoint.

Activates a newly registered student account by verifying the email token.

The token is sent to the user's email after registration. Once verified, the user's `email_verified` flag is set to true and the account becomes active.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** None required  
**Body (JSON):**
- `token` (string, required) — UUID token from the verification email

**Response:** 200 OK — success message  
**Notes:** Tokens expire after a set period. If expired, the user must re-register or request a new token.

Issues a new JWT access token using a valid refresh token.

Use this endpoint when the current access token has expired. The refresh token remains valid until it is used to log out or it expires naturally.

**Method:** POST

request.description:
Logs out the authenticated user by blacklisting their refresh token.

After logout, the refresh token can no longer be used to generate new access tokens. The user must log in again to obtain a new token pair.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required (`{{access_token}}`)  
**Body (JSON):**
- `refresh` (string, required) — the refresh token to blacklist

**Response:** 205 Reset Content

Sends a password reset email to the specified email address.

If the email belongs to a registered account, a reset link containing a `uid` and `token` is sent. The link is used in the Password Reset Confirm endpoint.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** None required  
**Body (JSON):**
- `email` (string, required)

**Response:** 200 OK — success message (response is the same whether or not the email exists, for security)

Completes the password reset flow by setting a new password using the uid and token from the reset email.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** None required  
**Body (JSON):**
- `uid` (string, required) — base64-encoded user ID from the reset link
- `token` (string, required) — password reset token from the reset link
- `new_password` (string, required)
- `confirm_password` (string, required) — must match new_password

**Response:** 200 OK — success message  
**Notes:** The token is single-use and expires after a short period.

Creates a new instructor account. Admin-only endpoint.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Admin role  
**Body (JSON):**
- `email` (string, required)
- `first_name` (string, required)
- `last_name` (string, required)
- `qualification` (string, optional)
- `specialization` (string, optional)

**Response:** 201 Created — instructor details

Allows a newly created instructor to set their password using the one-time token sent to their email.

This endpoint is used after an admin creates an instructor account. The instructor receives a token via email and uses it here to set their password and activate their account.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** None required  
**Body (JSON):**
- `token` (string, required) — one-time token from the instructor setup email
- `password` (string, required)

**Response:** 200 OK — success message

item.description:
Handles all authentication and user account management operations for the LMS.

This folder covers the full user lifecycle: student self-registration with email verification, JWT-based login and token refresh, secure logout via token blacklisting, and password reset via email. It also includes admin-only endpoints for creating instructor accounts and allowing instructors to set their initial password via a one-time token.

**Auth model:** Email-based JWT (SimpleJWT). After login, use the returned `access` token as a Bearer token for all protected endpoints. Store it in the `{{access_token}}` variable.

**Roles involved:** Student (self-register), Admin (create instructors), Instructor (set password)

item.name: Course

request.description:
Returns a list of courses. Students and unauthenticated users see only published courses. Instructors see their own courses plus all published courses. Admins see all courses regardless of status.

Supports filtering and search via query parameters.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Optional (unauthenticated users see published courses only)  
**Query params:**
- `search` — search by title or description
- `category` — filter by category ID
- `level` — filter by level (BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / ADVANCED)
- `status` — filter by status (admin/instructor only)

**Response:** 200 OK — list of courses

exec: pm.test("Course ID is a positive integer", () => {

request.description:
Creates a new course. Restricted to instructors and admins.

The authenticated instructor is automatically set as the course owner. New courses are created with a DRAFT status by default and must be explicitly published.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor or Admin role  
**Body (multipart/form-data or JSON):**
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, required)
- `category` (integer, required) — category ID
- `duration` (integer) — duration in months
- `price` (decimal)
- `level` (string) — BEGINNER / INTERMEDIATE / ADVANCED
- `thumbnail` (file, optional)
- `status` (string) — DRAFT / PUBLISHED / ARCHIVED

**Response:** 201 Created — course details

Retrieves the full details of a single course by its ID, including category, instructor, and metadata.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Optional (published courses are publicly accessible)  
**Path param:** `id` — course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — course object

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Python Basics Updated",
  "description": "Updated introduction to Python programming",
  "category": {{category_id}},
  "duration": 40,
  "price": "59.99",
  "level": "beginner",
  "status": "published"
}

request.description:
Fully replaces a course record. All fields must be provided. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PUT  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — course owner (Instructor) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)  
**Body:** All course fields (same as Create Course)

**Response:** 200 OK — updated course object  
**Notes:** Use PATCH (Update Course - Patch) for partial updates.

Partially updates a course record. Only the fields provided in the request body are updated. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — course owner (Instructor) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** Any subset of course fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated course object

Permanently deletes a course and all its associated data (lessons, assignments, quizzes, etc.). Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — course owner (Instructor) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content

item.description:
Provides full CRUD operations for managing courses on the platform.

Instructors can create, update, and delete their own courses. Students and unauthenticated users can only view published courses. Admins have full access across all courses. Each course belongs to a category and has metadata including level (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced), price, duration, and a thumbnail image.

**Roles involved:** Instructor (create/update/delete own courses), Admin (full access), Student (read published courses only)

item.name: Category

request.description:
Returns a list of all course categories. Accessible to all users including unauthenticated requests.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** None required

**Response:** 200 OK — list of category objects (id, name, slug, description)

Creates a new course category. Admin-only endpoint.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Admin role  
**Body (JSON):**
- `name` (string, required) — category name; slug is auto-generated
- `description` (string, optional)

**Response:** 201 Created — category object

Retrieves a single category by its ID.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** None required  
**Path param:** `id` — category ID (use `{{category_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — category object

Fully replaces a category record. All fields must be provided. Admin-only.

**Method:** PUT  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Admin role  
**Path param:** `id` — category ID (use `{{category_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** `name`, `description`

**Response:** 200 OK — updated category object

Partially updates a category. Only provided fields are updated. Admin-only.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Admin role  
**Path param:** `id` — category ID (use `{{category_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** Any subset of category fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated category object

Permanently deletes a category. Admin-only.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Admin role  
**Path param:** `id` — category ID (use `{{category_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content  
**Notes:** Deleting a category may affect courses linked to it. Ensure courses are reassigned before deletion.

item.description:
Manages course categories used to organise and filter courses on the platform.

Only admins can create, update, or delete categories. All users (including unauthenticated) can list and retrieve categories. Each category has a name, slug, and optional description.

**Roles involved:** Admin (write), Any user (read)

item.name: Profile

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's profile, including their role-specific profile data.

Students receive a `StudentProfile` (phone, biography, photo). Instructors receive an `InstructorProfile` (qualification, specialization, biography, phone, photo).

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  

**Response:** 200 OK — user object with nested profile

Partially updates the authenticated user's profile. Only the fields provided are updated.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Body (multipart/form-data or JSON):** Any subset of profile fields:
- `first_name`, `last_name`
- `phone`, `biography`
- `profile_photo` (file)
- Instructor-only: `qualification`, `specialization`

**Response:** 200 OK — updated profile object

item.description:
Allows authenticated users to view and update their own profile information.

The profile structure differs by role: students have a StudentProfile (phone, biography, photo) and instructors have an InstructorProfile (qualification, specialization, biography, phone, photo). The GET endpoint returns the full nested profile; PATCH allows partial updates.

**Roles involved:** Any authenticated user

item.name: Lesson

request.description:
Returns a list of lessons for a specific course. Students must be enrolled in the course to access lessons.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Query params:**
- `course` (integer, required) — filter by course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — list of lesson objects ordered by `order` field

exec: pm.test("Lesson order is a positive integer", () => {

request.description:
Creates a new lesson within a course. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Body (multipart/form-data or JSON):**
- `course` (integer, required) — course ID
- `title` (string, required)
- `content` (string) — text/HTML content
- `order` (integer, required) — position in the course curriculum; must be unique per course
- `video` (file, optional)
- `pdf` (file, optional)
- `audio` (file, optional)
- `external_resource` (URL, optional)

**Response:** 201 Created — lesson object

Retrieves the full details of a single lesson by its ID. Students must be enrolled in the parent course.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — lesson ID (use `{{lesson_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — lesson object

Fully replaces a lesson record. All fields must be provided. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PUT  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — lesson ID (use `{{lesson_id}}`)  
**Body:** All lesson fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated lesson object

Partially updates a lesson. Only provided fields are updated. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — lesson ID (use `{{lesson_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** Any subset of lesson fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated lesson object

Marks a lesson as complete for the authenticated student. Records a `LessonCompletion` entry used for progress tracking.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Student (must be enrolled in the course)  
**Path param:** `id` — lesson ID (use `{{lesson_id}}`)  
**Body:** None required

**Response:** 200 OK — success message  
**Notes:** Calling this endpoint again for an already-completed lesson is idempotent.

Permanently deletes a lesson. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — lesson ID (use `{{lesson_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content

item.description:
Manages lessons within a course. Each lesson belongs to a course and has an order that determines its position in the curriculum.

Instructors can create, update, and delete lessons for their own courses. Students who are enrolled in a course can view its lessons and mark individual lessons as complete, which tracks their progress. Lessons can include video, PDF, audio, and external resource links.

**Roles involved:** Instructor (create/update/delete), Enrolled Student (read + mark complete), Admin (full access)

item.name: Enrollment

request.description:
Returns a list of enrollments. Students see only their own enrollments. Admins see all enrollments across the platform.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required

**Response:** 200 OK — list of enrollment objects (student, course, enrolled_at)

exec: pm.test("enrolled_at is a valid ISO date string", () => {

request.description:
Enrolls the authenticated student in a course. A notification is automatically sent to the student upon successful enrollment.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Student role  
**Body (JSON):**
- `course` (integer, required) — course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 201 Created — enrollment object  
**Notes:** Students cannot enroll in the same course twice. Only published courses can be enrolled in.

Retrieves the details of a specific enrollment by its ID.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — enrollment ID (use `{{enrollment_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — enrollment object

Removes a student's enrollment from a course (unenroll). Students can only delete their own enrollment. Admins can delete any enrollment.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — enrollment ID (use `{{enrollment_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content

item.description:
Handles student enrollment in courses.

Students can enroll themselves in any published course, view their active enrollments, retrieve a specific enrollment, and unenroll (delete). Admins can view all enrollments across the platform. An enrollment notification is automatically sent to the student upon successful enrollment.

**Roles involved:** Student (enroll/view/delete own), Admin (view all)

item.name: Assignment

request.description:
Returns a list of assignments. Filter by course to see assignments for a specific course. Students see assignments for courses they are enrolled in. Instructors see assignments for their own courses.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Query params:**
- `course` (integer) — filter by course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — list of assignment objects

exec: pm.test("due_date is a valid date string", () => {

body.raw:
{
  "course": {{course_id}},
  "title": "Python Variables Assignment",
  "description": "Write a Python script demonstrating variable usage.",
  "due_date": "2027-01-01T23:59:00Z",
  "total_marks": 100
}

request.description:
Creates a new assignment for a course. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Body (JSON):**
- `course` (integer, required) — course ID
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, required)
- `due_date` (datetime, required) — ISO 8601 format
- `total_marks` (integer, required)

**Response:** 201 Created — assignment object

formdata.value: Assignment that includes an attachment file.

request.description:
Creates a new assignment with a file attachment (e.g. a PDF brief or resource document). Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Body (multipart/form-data):**
- `course` (integer, required)
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, required)
- `due_date` (datetime, required)
- `total_marks` (integer, required)
- `attachment` (file, required) — the assignment brief or resource file

**Response:** 201 Created — assignment object

Retrieves the full details of a single assignment by its ID.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — assignment ID (use `{{assignment_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — assignment object

Fully replaces an assignment record. All fields must be provided. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PUT  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — assignment ID (use `{{assignment_id}}`)  
**Body:** All assignment fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated assignment object

Partially updates an assignment. Only provided fields are updated. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — assignment ID (use `{{assignment_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** Any subset of assignment fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated assignment object

Permanently deletes an assignment and all its submissions. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — assignment ID (use `{{assignment_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content

item.description:
Manages assignments created by instructors for their courses.

Instructors can create assignments with a title, description, due date, total marks, and an optional file attachment. Students enrolled in the course can view assignments. Full CRUD is available to instructors and admins. Assignments are linked to a specific course.

**Roles involved:** Instructor (create/update/delete), Enrolled Student (read), Admin (full access)

item.name: Submission

request.description:
Returns a list of submissions. Students see only their own submissions. Instructors see all submissions for their assignments.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Query params:**
- `assignment` (integer) — filter by assignment ID

**Response:** 200 OK — list of submission objects

exec: pm.test("Grade is null on initial submission", () => {

request.description:
Submits a student's work for an assignment. Each student can only have one submission per assignment.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Student role  
**Body (multipart/form-data):**
- `assignment` (integer, required) — assignment ID
- `submission_file` (file, required) — the student's submitted work

**Response:** 201 Created — submission object  
**Notes:** To update a submission, use the Resubmit Assignment endpoint.

Retrieves the details of a specific submission by its ID, including grade and feedback if already graded.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — submission ID (use `{{submission_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — submission object

exec: pm.test("Submission file URL is updated and non-empty", () => {

request.description:
Replaces a student's existing submission with a new file. Used when a student wants to update their submitted work before the due date.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Student (submission owner)  
**Path param:** `id` — submission ID (use `{{submission_id}}`)  
**Body (multipart/form-data):**
- `submission_file` (file, required) — the updated submission file

**Response:** 200 OK — updated submission object

Permanently deletes a student's submission. Students can only delete their own submission. Admins can delete any submission.

**Method:** DELETE  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — submission ID (use `{{submission_id}}`)

**Response:** 204 No Content

Assigns a grade and optional feedback to a student's submission. Restricted to instructors and admins.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — submission ID (use `{{submission_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):**
- `grade` (integer, required) — numeric grade (must not exceed the assignment's `total_marks`)
- `feedback` (string, optional) — written feedback for the student

**Response:** 200 OK — updated submission object with grade and feedback

item.description:
Handles student submissions for assignments, including grading by instructors.

Students can submit their work (with a file upload), resubmit if needed, and delete their submission. Each student can only have one submission per assignment. Instructors can view all submissions for their assignments and assign a grade and feedback. The `Grade Assignment` request is restricted to instructors and admins.

**Roles involved:** Student (submit/resubmit/delete own), Instructor (view all + grade), Admin (full access)

item.name: Quiz

request.description:
Returns a list of quizzes. Filter by course to see quizzes for a specific course. Students see quizzes for enrolled courses only.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Query params:**
- `course` (integer) — filter by course ID (use `{{course_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — list of quiz objects

Creates a new quiz for a course. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin. Questions are added separately via the Quiz-questions folder.

**Method:** POST  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Body (JSON):**
- `course` (integer, required) — course ID
- `title` (string, required)
- `description` (string, optional)
- `duration` (integer, required) — time limit in minutes

**Response:** 201 Created — quiz object

Retrieves the full details of a single quiz by its ID, including its questions.

**Method:** GET  
**Auth:** Bearer token required  
**Path param:** `id` — quiz ID (use `{{quiz_id}}`)

**Response:** 200 OK — quiz object with nested questions

Fully replaces a quiz record. All fields must be provided. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PUT  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — quiz ID (use `{{quiz_id}}`)  
**Body:** All quiz fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated quiz object

Partially updates a quiz. Only provided fields are updated. Restricted to the course's instructor or an admin.

**Method:** PATCH  
**Auth:** Bearer token required — Instructor (course owner) or Admin  
**Path param:** `id` — quiz ID (use `{{quiz_id}}`)  
**Body (JSON):** Any subset of quiz fields

**Response:** 200 OK — updated quiz object
